notes: This is a place and a mood rather than a game type: the answers say outright that wandering and enjoying the trees and flowers is the whole point and that no collectibles or objectives are wanted, which is what separates it from Adventure — without something to find or reach there is no focal pull to build around. No Genre with the Explorable Place preset is the honest answer here rather than inventing a genre, and all five axes sit at their defaults, so it is a single-surface exterior map on P0. With no user to ask I took the wooded walk as the circulation grain, kept vignette-photo for the storybook compositions the answers describe, and read landmark-focal as a distinctive tree or clearing to orient by rather than a built structure. Scale is a short, dense walk per the answers, so nothing here needs a second zone.
